result.topic_en: A theorem on a lattice-point sum S(t, t+a+bi) along a segment in the complex plane, given separately for coprime a, b and for a, b with common divisor n, followed by a combination of 16 such terms and a count of lattice points in a parallelogram.
result.transcription:
Lit. Z.

Theorem
$S(t, t+a+bi)$ wenn a und b ganze Zahlen sind ohne gemeinschaftl. Theiler

$= a\,[-R-]\{+J+\}t + \frac{ab-a+b+1}{2} + J\,t(a-bi) - J[t][a-bi]$
Haben aber a und b den gemeinschaftlichen Theiler $=n$
$aRt + [-\frac{n(-1)ab}{2} + a^a-]$ $+ nJt(\frac{a}{n} - \frac{bi}{n}) - nJ[t](\frac{a}{n}-\frac{bi}{n})$
$\frac{ab - [-a-] a + b + n}{2}$

Also alle 16 vereinigt
$-4R1 + 4R2 - 8R3 + 8R4 + R6 - 3R7 - R8 - 2R9 + 3R11 + J6 - J8 - J5 - R(11+i) + R12$
$-R5$ $+J7$
$+2R(5+i)$ $-S(9, 9+1, 9+1+2i)$

Das Parallelogramm $x+iy,\ x'+iy',\ x'+a+(y'+b)i,\ x+a+(y+b)i$ enthalt
Puncte $b[x'] - b[x]$
$-a[y'] + a[y]$
$+[ay - bx]$ oder $n\left[\frac{ay}{n} - \frac{bx}{n}\right] - n\left[\frac{ay'}{n} - \frac{bx'}{n}\right]$
$-[ay' - bx']$
